title: Dua Faraj - Azumal Bala - Imam Mahdi (ATFS)

duas.title: Dua Faraj - Azumal Bala - Imam Mahdi (ATFS)
duas.description:
Du‘a’ al-Faraj- Invocation for the Advent of the Imam of the Age (‘atfs)
This dua'a is attributed to the living Imam Mehdi (atfs). It brings immediate help from our living imam. It is recommended to be recited often
If a person find himself surrounded by misfortunes or intrigues he must recite this dua'a to come through tight situations, deadlock and crises.

segments.translation: O my Lord! The calamity has aggravated; the absence prolonged;
The curtain of modesty has been lifted; hope has been curtailed;
The earth has been narrow; and sky has been denied.
And You are the One from whom help is sought and complaints are made

segments.arabic: وَ عَلَيْكَ الْمُعَوَّلُ فِيْ الشِّدَّةِ وَالرَّخَاءِ،
segments.translation: And in You we trust in the times of difficulty.

segments.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَي مُحَمَّدٍ وَّآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
segments.transliteration: Allahumma salli ‘ala Muhammad wa ali Muhammad
segments.translation: O Allah! Send blessings upon Muhammad (S) and the progeny of Muhammad (S),

segments.arabic: أُوْلِي الْأَمْرِ الَّذِيْنَ فَرَضْتَ عَلَيْنَا طَا عَتَهُمْ
segments.translation: The possessors of authority whose obedience you have enjoined upon us

segments.arabic: وَ عَرَّفْتَنَا بِذَالِكَ مَنْزِلَتَهُمْ ، فَفَّرِجْ عَنَّا بِحَقِّهِمْ فَرَجاً عَاجِلاً قَرِيْباً كَلَمْحِ الْبَصَرِ أَوْ هُوَ أَقْرَبُ
segments.transliteration: Wa ‘arraftana bidhalika manzilatahum fafarrij ‘anna bi-haqqihim farajan ‘ajilan qariban kalamhi’l-basari aw huwa aqrab
segments.translation: And by that made us aware of their position. Then make open for us, by their truth, an immediate opening, immediate as a wink or sooner.
O Muhammad! O ‘Ali! O ‘Ali! O Muhammad!

segments.arabic: ِكْفِيَانِيْ فَإِنَّكُمَا كَافِيَانِ وَ انْصُرَانِيْ فَإِنَّكُمَا نَاصِرَانِ
segments.transliteration: Ikfiyani fainnakuma kafiyani wa’n-surani fainnakuma nasiran
segments.translation: Suffice me both of you as both of you are sufficient.Help me—two of you—for you are my helpers.
O our Master, O Master of the Time!
Help! Help!
Rescue me! Rescue me! Rescue me!
This moment! This moment! This moment!

duas.content: You may then slap your right thigh with your hand three times and, at each time, say the following words:
duas.title: Instruction Block

segments.translation: Hasten, hasten, hasten!

segments.arabic: يَا أَرْحَمَ لرَّاحِمِيْنَ بِحَقِّ مُحَمَّدٍ وَّآلِهِ الطَّا هِرِيْنَ
segments.transliteration: Ya arhama’r-rahimina bi-haqqi Muhammad wa alihi’t-tahirin
segments.translation: O Most Merciful of the Merciful,For the sake of Muhammad (S) and his holy progeny.

duas.title: Reference
duas.content:
Shaykh Tabarsi (a.r.), the renowned commentator of the Holy Quran, has recorded this supplication in his book ‘Kunooz al-Najaah’ and says, ‘This supplication was taught by our master Saaheb al-Zamaan (a.t.f.s.) to Abul Hasan Muhammad Ibn Ahmad Ibn Abi al-Lais in the city of Baghdad at the Graves of Quraish ( مقابر قريش ), where the latter had taken refuge, due to fear of death. On account of the blessings of this supplication, he was saved. 
Al-Baladul Ameen: 607; Al- Mizar by Shaheed: 231; Al- Misbaah: 235; Minhajil Arifeen: 483.

duas.title: Method of Salaat (Amaal)
duas.content:
Two rak’ats.
In each unit, Surah al-Hamd is recited, and the verse below within Sura Hamd is repeated 100 times;
iyyaka na`budu wa-iyyaka nasta`in(u) 
then recite Surah al-Tawheed once 
Second rakaat in the same manner as above. 
After completion of the Salat recite this version of Dua faraj

duas.title: Dua Faraj - Azumal Bala - Imam Mahdi (ATFS) - (Alternate version)

segments.translation: O Allah, unbearable is our tribulation!
The hidden has been disclosed!
The cover has been exposed!

segments.transliteration: wa daqat al-ardu bima wasa`at alssama'u
segments.translation: The earth has become too narrow to carry that which could be embraced by the sky.
To You, my Lord, is the complaint
and in You is the trust in sorrow and in joy.

segments.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
segments.transliteration: allahumma salli `ala muhammadin wa ali muhammadin
segments.translation: O Allah, send blessings to Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad
whom You have commanded us to obey,
and hasten their Relief through the Rising Imam among them;
and make manifest Your fortifying him.
O Muhammad! O `Ali!
O `Ali! O Muhammad!
Save me, for you both are true saviors of me.
O Muhammad! O `Ali!
O `Ali! O Muhammad!
Aid me, for you both are true aides of me.
O Muhammad! O `Ali!
O `Ali! O Muhammad!
Protect me, for you both are true protectors of me.
O my master, the Patron of the Age!
O my master, the Patron of the Age!
O my master, the Patron of the Age!
Help, help, help!
[come to] succor me, [come to] succor me, [come to] succor me!
[grant me] security, [grant me] security, [grant me] security!

duas.reference: Jamaal al-Usboo’, p. 170; Behaar al-Anwaar, vol. 91, p. 190; Wasaael al-Shia, vol. 8, p. 185

duas.title: Method
duas.content:
One who has a need should perform Ghusl on Friday eve after midnight, and come to the place of prayers and perform 

two rakats (units) prayer and in the 
first rakat he should recite Surah al-Hamd and when he reaches: 
“Iyyaka Na’budoo we iyyaka Nastaeen”, ’they should repeat this a hundred times and continue with the Surah and after that recite Surah Tawheed once.
Then he should perform the Ruku (bowing) and Sajdahs (prostration) and therein recite the 
recitations of Ruku and Sajdah seven times.
Then recite the second rakat also in the same manner 

and then recite the following supplication. The Almighty Allah would fulfill his needs, whatever sort of a person he is, however he should not be of those who have broken off relation with his relatives. The supplication is as follows:

segments.transliteration: Allaahumma in at’a’tuka fal mah’madatu lak.
segments.translation: O Allah, if I obey You, then the essence of praise is for You,
and if I disobey You then the Proof is for You.
From You is comfort and from You is success.
Glory be to the one who has bestowed favors and thanked.
Glory be to the One who commanded and forgave.

segments.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنْ كُنْتُ عَصَيْتُكَ فَإنِّیْ قَدْ اَطَعْتُكَ فِىْ اَحَبِّ اْلاَشْيَاءِ إِلَيْكَ وَ هُوَ الإِيْمَانُ بِكَ
segments.transliteration: llaahumma in kuntu a’s’aituka fa-innee qad at’a’tuka fee ah’abbil ashyaa-i ilaika wahuwal eemaanu bika
segments.translation: O Allah, if I am disobedient to you, then I indeed I have also obeyed You in those matters that You prefer most, and it is belief (faith) in You.

segments.arabic: لَمْ اَتَّخِذْ لَك وَلَدًا وَّ لَمْ اَدْعُ لَك شَرِيْكًا
segments.transliteration: lam attakhidh laka waladanw wa lam ad-u’ laka shareekam
segments.translation: I have not taken for You any son and neither have I considered anyone Your partner

segments.arabic: مَنًّا مِنْكَ بِهِ عَلَىَّ لاَ مَنَّا مِنِّیْ بِهِ عَلَيْكَ
segments.transliteration: mannaa minka bihi a’layya laa mannam minni bihi a’laika
segments.translation: even then the favor is from you upon me and there is no favor from me upon You.

segments.arabic: وَ قَدْ عَصَيْتُكَ يَا إِلٰهِىْ عَلٰی غَيْرِ وَجْهِ الْمُكَابَرَةِ
segments.transliteration: wa qad a’s’aituka yaa ilaahee a’laa ghairi wajhil mukaabarati
segments.translation: Also I have indeed disobeyed You O My Allah, this disobedience was not due to pride

segments.arabic: وَ لاَ الْخُرُوْجِ عَنْ عُبُوْدِيَّتِكَ وَ لاَ الْجُحُوْدِ لِرُبُوْبِيَّتِكَ
segments.transliteration: wa lal khurooji a’n u’boodeeyatika wa lal juh’oodi liruboobeeyatika
segments.translation: or due to leaving Your worship or due to the denial of Allah.

segments.arabic: وَ لٰكِنْ اَطَعْتُ هَوٰاىَ وَ اَزَلَّنِيْ الشَّيْطَانُ
segments.transliteration: wa laakin at’a’tu hawaaya wa azallanish shait’aanu
segments.translation: It is only that I have obeyed my desires and the Satan misled me.
Then Your proof is complete upon me and Your decision.

segments.arabic: فَإِنْ تُعَذِّبْنِيْ فَبِذُنُوْبِىْ غَيْرُ ظَالِمٍ لِىْ،
segments.transliteration: fa-in tuadhdhibnee fabidhunoobee ghairu z’aalimil lee.
segments.translation: Then if You punish me for my sins, You would not be unjust to me.

segments.arabic: وَ إِنْ تَغْفِرْ لِىْ وَ تَرْحَمْنِيْ فَإِنَّكَ جَوَادٌ كَرِيْمٌ
segments.transliteration: Wa in taghfirlee wa tarh’amnee fa-innaka jawaadun kareemun
segments.translation: But if You forgive me and have mercy on me, then indeed You are the Generous, the Kind,
O Kind O Kind ….

duas.content:
(till the breath breaks). 
Then say after this:
duas.title: Instruction Block

segments.arabic: يَا آمِنًا مِنْ كُلِّ شَیْءٍ وَ كُلُّ شَىْءٍ مِنْكَ خَائِفٌ حَذِرٌ
segments.transliteration: Yaa aaminam min kulli shai-inw wa kullu shai-im minka khaa-ifun h’adhirun
segments.translation: O One Who is safe from everything and everything is fearful of Him.

segments.arabic: اَسْاَلُكَ بِاَمْنِكَ مِنْ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ وَ خَوْفِ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ مِنْك
segments.transliteration: as-aluka bi-amnika min kulli shai-inw wa khaufi kulli shai-im minka
segments.translation: I ask in the name of this safety and in the name of the fearfulness of everything

segments.arabic: اَنْ تُصَلِّىَ عَلٰی مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
segments.transliteration: an tus’alliya a’laa muh’ammadinw wa aali muh’ammad.
segments.translation: that You bless Muhammad and the Progeny of Muhammad

segments.arabic: وَ اَنْ تُعْطِيَنِيْ اَمَانًا لِنَفْسِىْ وَ اَهْلِىْ وَ وَلَدِىْ وَ سَائِرِ مَا اَنْعَمْتَ بِهِ عَلَىَّ
segments.transliteration: Wa antut’ t’iyanee amaanal linafsee wa ahlee wa waladee wa saa-iri maa an-a’mta bihi a’layya
segments.translation: and accord me safety in my self, my family and my children,

segments.arabic: حَتَّی لاَ اَخَافَ وَ لاَ اَحْذَرَ مِنْ شَىْءٍ اَبَدًا
segments.transliteration: h’atta laa akhaafa wa laa ah’dhara min shai-in abadan
segments.translation: so in me also no fear remains of anything, ever.
You are powerful over everything

segments.arabic: وَ حَسْبُنَا اللهُ وَ نِعْمَ الْوَكِيْلُ
segments.translation: and Allah is sufficient for us and the best of the executors.

segments.arabic: يَا كَافِىَ إبْرَاهِيْمَ نَمْرُوْدَ وَ يَا كَافِىَ مُوْسٰی فِرْعَوْنَ
segments.transliteration: Yaa kaafiya ibraaheema numrooda wa yaa kaafiya moosaa fira’una
segments.translation: O one who sufficed for Ibrahim against Nimrod and sufficed for Musa against Pharaoh.

segments.arabic: اَسْاَلَُكَ اَنْ تُصَلِّىَ عَلٰی مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
segments.transliteration: as-aluka antus’alliya a’laa muh’ammadinw wa aali muh’ammadinw
segments.translation: I beseech You that You bless Muhammad and the Progeny of Muhammad

segments.arabic: اَنْ تَكْفِيَنِيْ شَرَّ فُلاَنَ بْنَ فُلاَنٍ.
segments.translation: and be sufficient for me against the mischief of the enemy.
(Then soon Allah would prevent the mischief of one whose mischief one fears)

duas.content: Then prostrate and ask for the needs, and beseech Allah. No believing man or woman ever recites this sincerely except that the doors of heavens open to fulfil his or her needs and it will be accepted at that very moment at the place he or she is and this is a blessing of Allah upon the people.
duas.title: Instruction Block
